'''Section IG-44''' was a sector of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] [[Riot clone trooper/Legends|riot troopers]] spotted who they believed to be [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] fleeing towards that sector after it was suspected by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|police]] that Kryze had murdered [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]].
